q1.question: Is Track My Money free to use?
q1.answer: Yes! Track My Money is completely free for personal use. We believe everyone deserves access to quality financial tools.

q2.question: How secure is my financial data?
q2.answer: Your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never share your information with third parties and follow industry-standard security practices.

q3.question: Can I track expenses in multiple currencies?
q3.answer: Currently, Track My Money supports single-currency tracking per account. Multi-currency support is on our roadmap.

q4.question: How do recurring transactions work?
q4.answer: You can set up recurring transactions for regular payments like subscriptions, rent, or salary. They are automatically tracked on the schedule you define.

q5.question: Can I export my data?
q5.answer: Yes, you can export your transaction history and reports in CSV format at any time from the settings page.
